items.description: Role tasks entry point — includes all sub-task files in order
items.notes: Orchestrates validate_credentials, install, and init task files in order.

items.description: Role default variables — redis_port, redis_password (Vault), maxmemory_mb, maxmemory_policy, myapp version/url/install_dir
items.notes: All class parameter defaults converted to Ansible role variables with role prefix. redis_password is credential-injected (no default). secure_logging toggle added.

items.description: Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation — generate after defaults/main.yml is written; covers redis_port, redis_password, maxmemory_mb, maxmemory_policy
items.notes: All role parameters documented including credential variables injected by AAP at runtime.

items.description: Role handlers — e.g. restart redis service handler

Convert init.pp: health-check URI fetch + write JSON, myapp deploy (slurp/get_url/unarchive/copy), myFormatType1 (company_app_conf custom module), myCronType1 (ansible.builtin.cron), mySecretType1 (NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — flag for developer review), mySecretFunction1 (NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — flag for developer review), PuppetDB peer discovery replaced with inventory group variable
items.notes: Fixed 3 issues: (1) Cat1 - added 'Ensure /var/lib/redis directory exists' before Write health_check.json; (2) Cat2 - added stat guard on /etc/company/ dir before company_app_conf tasks (CompanyApp not installed by role); (3) Cat2 - added stat guard on /usr/local/bin/redis-backup.sh before cron task (script not deployed by role).

items.description: Convert install.pp: install and configure Redis (package, service, config via ansible.builtin modules), manage /var/log/redis directory (owner redis:redis, mode 0755)
items.notes: No issues found. Package install precedes log dir creation, config deploy, and service start. redis user/group created by package. /etc/redis/ created by package.

items.description: Custom Ansible module implementing myFormatType1/myFormatProvider1 behaviour — manages !key=value entries in proprietary CompanyApp settings file (/etc/company/app.conf); preserves non-matching lines verbatim; idempotent present/absent states
items.notes: Custom Python Ansible module implementing !key=value CompanyApp settings file management, converted from myFormatType1/myFormatProvider1 Puppet type+provider.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via a single ansible.builtin.include_role task
items.notes: Single include_role task for profile_redis_cluster_case3. No faked filesystem state.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (exists, owner redis:redis, mode 0644, valid JSON), /var/log/redis (directory, owner redis:redis, mode 0755), /etc/company/app.conf (contains !app-mode=cluster and !health-port=8080), /opt/myapp/version.txt (contains 2.1.0), Redis ping, health endpoint JSON response
items.notes: Split into 2 plays (~15 tasks each). Play 1: stat+slurp checks for /var/log/redis, /opt/myapp, version.txt, health_check.json, app.conf, redis-backup.sh, schedulerctl. Play 2: service_facts for redis.service, wait_for port 6379, crontab check for redis-backup entry.
